notes: Complete second reading of the original whole page once and the two existing native overlapping halves once each, against both witnesses and the consolidation. This included the entire agreed prose, all formula tokens, diagram ends and labels, insertions, cancellations, margin and foliation, rather than sampling first-pass differences.

Two punctuation removals are proposed in the oblique note. They do not alter the neighboring words or formula. The root independently viewed the same existing crop and agreed that neither a separate comma after the parenthesis nor a separate point after Y is visible.

All 14 inventory elements were accounted for and the full sheet was checked for missing elements. No further diagram, drawing, insertion or marginal fragment was found. There is no author page number; archive folio 83 remains transcribed.
The four retained doubtful loci remain unresolved. No certainty was raised merely because the witnesses or the first consolidated page agree.
Five existing crops were reused; no new crop or recrop was made. The quoted crop box for both proposed punctuation changes is the actual box of the saved rotated margin crop.
